module: Node "Set Variable" (repeat_instant, hidden from the menus). Writes a graph or project variable from an input pin bearing its name and type. Handles renaming and type changes while keeping compatible links; copies flow to the output.
notes: The global field is nil until setGlobal is called.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

init.desc: varName = nil, target = graph variables, useSuffix = false.

setGlobal.desc: Changes the scope (project/graph), the color and removes the current pin.

drawCustomProperties.desc: Scope checkbox, variable list and variable editor.

setVar.desc: Chooses the variable: recreates the input pin and redoes the links.

renameVariable.desc: Hook: updates node and pin if the variable is renamed.

work.desc: Calls target:change(varName, pin value) and copies flow.

typeUpdated.desc: Hook: recreates the pin when the variable's type changes.

drawMiddle.desc: Draws the central content of the node in the editor.

_onSerialize.desc: Saves the node's state in the given table.
